title: Melphiro
text: My father watched the footage with narrowed eyes, as if he were looking at something distasteful.
“Raph”
My father keeps petting the Raph.
“What on earth is Trash up to right now?”
“He’s being held captive in the castle. By the Queen’s orders, he’s been forced to walk around the castle in a humiliating outfit. There’s footage of that, too.”

Included is footage of him being paraded through the castle like a sideshow after the tiger siblings’ reunion, as punishment from the Queen. This time, it’s the “Naked Emperor” style. I somehow feel he looks rather majestic, but it’s a comical sight.
“…His face doesn’t look humiliated, though.”
“Oh my—”
“Well… since this punishment is being carried out on the Queen’s orders, I can’t really say much about it…”
The Immortal replied, seeming to struggle for the right words.
“Wouldn’t it be best to just point and laugh? Or perhaps, Father, would you like to go throw some rotten food at him?”
“What kind of person do you think I am, anyway?!”
Oh? I’ve just been yelled at by my Father. Is this the Father inside me?
“My Father is the most important person to me—irreplaceable and precious above all else.”
Just like Filo-tan, he’s the one who supports me emotionally. Even if he hates me, I’ve decided to devote myself to him.
“You’re saying something disgusting again… I’m asking if you think I’m the kind of guy who’d go out of my way to throw rotten things at someone!”
“I know full well that you laugh while stomping on the heads of those who resist because they don’t want to prostrate themselves.”
“Guh…”

Oh? For some reason, my Father is at a loss for words. I knew this because I heard it from Crimson Swine back when he came crying to me. Now I’d think, “Serves you right,” if I were being stomped on, but back then, it was a bitter, angry memory.
“Will you stomp on my head, too? I think—despite appearances—it’s a head that’s easy to stomp on.”
If that’s what it takes to satisfy Father’s anger, I’d be happy for him to stomp on it as much as he likes. I’ll be licking the ground, won’t I?
“You can stomp on it even more.”
That’s just how sinful I am, after all.
“Stop it… Damn it.”
For some reason, Father is backing away.
“Oh my… Naofumi-chan, you’re quite the little rascal, aren’t you?”

“I think it’s a bit much to just brush it off as ‘mischievous’… Damn it! Anyway, I just like humiliating people I can’t stand! I don’t have a hobby of doing stuff like that for no reason! Anyway… that guy doesn’t even look like he’s feeling humiliated. What a pain.”
He’s had his heart broken, after all. He’s probably lost even the capacity to feel humiliation.

“It seems the Trash General is confronting his own sins… and is also trying to find a way to reconcile with His Lordship, the Shield Hero. I can only pray that the time will come when the two of them can join hands…”
It was a moment when the Hermit clasped his hands together in prayer. But I haven’t forgiven that Trash!
“I don’t know what’s going on, but it’s not uncommon to have a strange employer. I look forward to working with you from now on.”
And so, without reading the room, Tiger Guy joined our ranks.
It’s been a little while since Tiger Guy came to the village. His Finacée has been entrusted with managing the neighboring town.

I’ve been watching from afar as Filo-tan often goes there to visit. She’s been working on developing the neighboring town in various ways. By the way, Éclair has already set out on a training journey with Big Sister. Once she returns from her training, she’ll likely take on the role of guarding her Finacée.

Ah, just so you know, I’ve been training with my future Father and teaching him how to use Ki. I’m gently channeling Ki into him so he can get a feel for it. He’ll pick it up in no time. Anyway, this happened one day.
“Hey, Naofumi… oh, the Spear Hero is here too. Perfect timing.”
My Finacée descended from the sky, riding on Filo-tan’s back. Eek…
“The Spear Guy—how lovely!”
Filo-tan’s eyes are sparkling. S-should I give her something to eat to distract her?
“Ah, it’s Filo, isn’t it? This is perfect. Let’s have a race.”
“Eh—right now, Filo’s more interested in talking to the Spear Guy than running.”
“W-well, didn’t you come here for some business other than to see me?”
“Oh, right—that’s right.”
Filo-tan is nodding repeatedly while glancing at me. Ugh… this is it. I take a marshmallow out of my spear and hand it to Filo-tan.
“Something white and fluffy?”
“It’s a marshmallow. It’s delicious just as it is, but it’s also delicious when toasted over a fire.”
I impaled it on the tip of my spear, lightly toasted it over the fire, and held it out near Filo-tan’s mouth. Filo-tan placed her hand on the spearhead and popped the marshmallow into her mouth.
“Wow, it’s so fluffy—yummy! Thanks, Spear Guy!”
“Go ahead and eat as much as you like.”
“Yay!”
My father was watching the whole scene.
“Motoyasu… Filo’s been clinging to you.”
“That’s right. Filo-chan, you shouldn’t get too cozy with the Spear Hero.”
“Eh… but the Spear Guy’s been giving me all sorts of things lately, you know?”
“It seems he’s trying to distract you.”
“Hmm?”
Filo-tan tilted her head in confusion, but my Father turned his attention to his Finacée.
“Anyway, I digress. What is it, Melty?”
My Finacée comes over to my Father… and hands him a strange compact. It’s the kind with a mirror inside when you open it. It’s glittery and decorated with all sorts of embellishments.
“Some kid named Gaelion tried to shove this weird thing on me and Filo-tan…”
“It’s all sparkly!”
A Rival, and he’s targeting my Finacée and Filo-tan?
“Why would that Decoder Book be with you two?”
“I don’t know. It said to open this compact, hold my hand over it, and say ‘Double R'yne Wing.’”
My Father furrows his brow and looks back and forth between my Finacée and Filo-tan.
“…I’ve got a really bad feeling about this, but why don’t you just do as you’re told?”
“Why do I have to do it when I know it’s a trap?”
“Wait, is this the thing Itsuki mentioned before—where he said to pair up Melty and Filo and make them do it?”
“Filo-chan doesn’t want to do it, does she?”
“Huh? Hmm… I hate Gaelion, but I like the sparkly stuff because it’s pretty? Also—the Spear Guy gave me all sorts of stuff, so he told me to just do it.”
That’s the mindset of “accessories aren’t to blame!” Just as you’d expect from Filo-tan.

“That said… is it really a good idea to let the villagers handle this? Even when I appraised it with my shield, it’s just a magical accessory—no curses or strange mechanisms attached. It’s unnecessarily high-performance, so it looks like it’d be good for you guys to equip.”
Tuned Dress-Up Compact (Exclusive to Princess Melty and Filo) – Boosts All Four Elemental Magic Power (Large) – Robe of Magical Power – Ability Unlock – Quality: High Quality
Even I could tell it had these strange effects. You rival! What are you up to?!
“Just try it out, anyway.”
“Ugh… Fine. Alright then, Filo-tan.”
“Got it!”
Filo-tan and her Finacée open the compact and hold their hands over it.
“‘Double Rainbow Wing’!”

Immediately, a rainbow-colored light burst from the compact and enveloped the Finacée and Filo-tan. Whoa! Through the light, I can see Filo-tan. Her clothes are shifting shape along with the light, transforming from a one-piece dress into a mini-dress. Her hair has become twin tails.
T-this is a feast for the eyes! What a truly magnificent sight!
And, as if to match her, her Finacée’s outfit also changed—she’s now wearing a mini-dress in colors opposite to Filo-tan’s. Her hair has become long—the opposite of Filo-tan.

Is it thread made from Magical Power materials? It looks like it’s already shaped into clothing, even though it should first be turned into thread. Eventually, the rainbow-colored light dispersed, revealing her form.
“Rafu.”

A silence fell between my Father and my Finacée. A little while later, the Finacée’s face began to flush red before my very eyes. The Raph—I wonder where he got them—was wearing sunglasses as he watched Filo-tan’s magnificent outfit transform.
“W-What is this!?”
“That was a transformation scene. If you’re watching from somewhere, come out already!”
“Nooo!”
My rival, who had been hiding somewhere, came fluttering down from the sky.
“What’s this?”
“It’s a transformation item. I crafted it with a lot of ingenuity—without using any dragon-derived materials—so that Filo could use it!”
It’s exactly what it looks like. It reminded me of those transformation heroine shows that my male friends—the ones who told me my likability score—used to talk about so passionately.
“It’s not like we’re Itsuki or Ren… So you two are ‘Merfilo,’ huh?”
“Oh? That’s a good name. From now on, the princess and Filo will become the transformation heroines—the legendary warriors known as Merphilo—and set out to save the world.”
Oh? Is my Finacée making her debut as a Filolial Mask, too? If so, that’s reassuring. I fully recognize my Finacée’s character and abilities.
“No way!”
“It seems Itsuki and the others are going the hero route and performing all over the place… but now Filo and Melty are being forced to make their debut too? That’s tough. Good luck with that.”
“Why are you acting like it’s none of your business?!”
“Should I prepare a theme song for you guys?”
“I don’t need one!”

“Mel-chan, Mel-chan, can Filo and the others do the fun stuff that the Archer and the others are doing? To those who’ve done bad things… ‘It’s your bad luck that you showed up right in front of Filo—you’re going to be Filo’s dinner!’ Then you clap your hands with Mel-chan, say ‘Marble Blast,’ and cast Magic, right?　That’s what the sword guy and the archer said.”
“Those guys never say anything useful, do they?”
“Listen, Filo-chan, I think you should just be yourself—you don’t need to do anything like that. And that line is kind of off, anyway.”

Oh… so Filo-tan is putting on a hero show! I can’t miss this! It’s way more exciting than watching Itsuki and Ren fight to catch villains! When Filo-tan and her fiancé are in a pinch, Philoreal Mask No. 1 will dashingly appear to save the day. What a wonderful dynamic.
“Is that so? But it sounds like fun.”
“Motoyasu-sama… you there, Dragon! Don’t you have one for Yuki?”
Ignoring me—who’s all excited by the lovely sight of Filo-tan and the others—Yuki-chan asks her Rival.
“Naofumi should be the one doing this.”
“Why am I the one playing the heroine role?! Oh, it’d be fun to make Raph-chan dress up like that.”
“Raph-hu.”
My father from the first world did all sorts of cosplay involving the Rafu race later on. In a way, wasn’t that just a hobby of his?
“What are you even talking about, Naofumi? What would you do if Raphtalia ended up looking like that?”
“Hmm…”
My father began to think for a moment.
“I can’t help but think it’s the ‘transforming heroine’ route. If it boosts her physical abilities, letting her use it might be a good idea.”
“You’re so focused on efficiency… I can really see how hard Raphtalia must have had it.”

“What nonsense are you talking about…? Raphtalia is the type who, when asked if there’s any accessory she wants, demands something practical. If it’s that high-performance, she’d want it, wouldn’t she?”
Come to think of it, I do get the feeling my Big Sister is the type to be pragmatic about that sort of thing.
“I’ll make it if I feel like it.”

“I’m looking forward to seeing it finished. I wonder what kind of outfit would be best for Raphtalia… Given her apparent age, a sailor uniform might be the safe bet? No, that would be a bit old-fashioned… Besides, it seems like it’d be a bit different from the style of Melty and Filo’s outfits anyway.”
“Reaally?”
“Anyway, we’re getting off topic—don’t do anything weird with the decryption book. Alright, that’s all. Dismissed. Scatter, scatter.”
My father waves his hand while petting the Raph seed, urging everyone to disperse.
“Mel-chan, Mel-chan, let’s go for a walk! Filo can fly, so we can go anywhere!”
“Hey, Filo-chan! Oh, for heaven’s sake…”

My Finacée hopped onto Filo-tan and flew high into the sky. After that, I started hearing stories about Filo-tan and the others. Most of them were related to taverns, but it seems she started an idol career together with Filo-tan.

My Finacée plays music while Filo-tan sings and dances. I’ve heard that partway through the show, they became “Merfilo” and really got the crowd going! What a wonderful show! Turning a Rival’s scheme to her advantage in a completely different way—she’s quite the one!

Of course, it seems Filo-tan wasn’t about to let Fleon-chan outshine her—she’d transform into a hero to catch mischievous thieves. The country is abuzz with all sorts of rumors. I hear Ren and Itsuki were also busy maintaining public order all over the place, even going so far as to deliberately create the appearance of causing trouble in order to thwart the Three Heroes Church’s schemes. With all that going on, it seems Filo-tan and my Finacée have made their hero debuts.
